paragraphs: R' Felipa bar Peruta, at the end of Megillah, chapter 1, halakhah 1; Soferim, chapter 21, halakhah 7, has R' Polita…

notes.text: סה״א is read contextually as end of halakhah 1 following Megillah chapter 1. Soferim פ״כא ה״ז giveschapter 21 halakhah 7. The Megillah corpus and both edition schemes are not independently verified.

The final bar-Parim continues Polita’s name across preserved source units; the added English ellipses show that continuity rather than missing words. Supplied internal period after Polita does not create a new person. Older separate פרים machine line and Parim/Perim vowel uncertainty remain source-boundary limits. Felipa and Polita are distinct supplied forms, not an admitted identity; both title abbreviations remain R'.
